brief_rationale: The doctor met all 8 responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors, conducted thorough workspace queries, provided clear instructions on hypoglycemia/ketosis precautions, and obtained teach-back verification. HO2 (real-world constraint navigation) was completed by building stepwise fallback plans for medication verification barriers. HO3 (misinformation correction) was completed by correcting patient beliefs about stopping insulin. No high-order credit beyond minimum safety was demonstrated for HO1 or HO4. The trajectory achieved Strong grade.
